title: Subprocess Fork Indirection Bypasses In-Process Component Architecture
summary: Multiple critical subsystems, notably the MCP server bridge in pkg/mcp/cli_bridge.go and the scheduler convergence engine in pkg/scheduler/convergence_engine.go, execute core domain operations by shelling out to the bin/zqk CLI binary via os/exec (exec.CommandContext), capturing stdout strings, regex-scrubbing log lines, and re-deserializing JSON, rather than invoking in-process Go packages. recommendation: Refactor pkg/mcp and pkg/scheduler to invoke domain operations directly via in-process Go application interfaces (e.g. cli.ExecuteInProcess or domain service layers). citations.point: Component Boundaries: Crossing component boundaries within a single application process must not be mediated through operating system subprocess boundaries unless physical isolation is explicitly required.

title: Asymmetric Persistence Guarantees and Interface Contract Divergence in ObjectStorageProvider
summary: The primary storage contract (ObjectStorageProvider in pkg/storage/object_storage_interface.go) defines a monolithic 25-method interface implemented by both FileObjectStorage and GraphObjectStorage, but their behavioral guarantees completely diverge.
